blocks.text: Shown only when Google or GitHub vouches for the address (Google email_verified, a verified GitHub address). Only the found account's own sign-in buttons appear; signing in with one of them links the new method ("Google is now linked to this account."). Separate accounts stay a deliberate choice; nothing is created silently.
